decisions.evidence: Increasing retrieval depth helps direct questions but gives diminishing returns on multi-hop questions when relevant passages are not jointly selected.
The question, a compact separator, and the selected passages are concatenated into the input of a Seq2Seq Generator.
RetGen combines retrieval and generation for Open-domain QA. It first uses DenseRet to retrieve passages, then conditions a Seq2Seq Generator on the question and the retrieved evidence.
